title: Unique Umami Turkish Rhubarb Stew
description: A quick and flavorful Turkish stew featuring rhubarb and confit tomato, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This egg-free friendly dish is cooked in a hot pot vessel and has a winey, glassy-jelly texture.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the rhubarb, confit tomato, red wine, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper to the hot pot vessel.
Stir all the ingredients together, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the rhubarb is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
